question: can a per-runtime linear map (head-space affine or Procrustes) fit on paired MLX/CUDA states close the ~6-point structured t2i residual
protocol: fit on captions of eval-tail images 0-499 (2500 pairs), evaluate t2i on captions of images 500-999 (2500 held-out queries) vs the full 1000-image gallery (external frame)
conclusion: NEGATIVE: global linear correction at 2500 pairs is a wash vs the 42KB mean (+0.3 Procrustes, -1.2 ridge); small-N overfits far below baseline. The structured residual is input-dependent, not a fixed linear transform. The 42KB per-runtime mean is essentially optimal within the linear-correction family, which upgrades 'at most a 42KB recalibration' from a convenience claim to a measured stopping point.
